subject: Order Form negotiation: pricing, minimum commit, net terms
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@brightbridgehealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightbridgehealth.com>
Date: 2026-02-16T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Order form commercial items — need confirmation

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited. We have the Master Services Agreement already in place, but procurement asked us to lock down the Order Form commercials before legal will sign. Two quick items they asked me to confirm:

- Pricing schedule: can you confirm list vs. committed discount tiers and whether usage overage rates apply?
- Payment terms & invoicing: they prefer Net 60; we typically invoice monthly via PO. Also need VAT/tax handling (we're US-based but have international nodes).

I attached your latest Order Form (v1) for reference — can you send a redlined version and a short summary of the commercial concessions? If possible we'd like to close this week.

Attachments: BrightBridge_OrderForm_v1.pdf (PDF, 95KB)

Thanks,
Sarah Nguyen
Head of Procurement
BrightBridge Health
[sarah.nguyen@brightbridgehealth.com | +1 415-555-0172]

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@brightbridgehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightbridgehealth.com>
Date: 2026-02-16T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Order form commercial items — need confirmation

Hi Sarah — great to hear and glad the demo landed well.

Quick summary up front:
- Pricing: we propose a committed schedule with tiered discounts. Minimum commit: $50,000 ARR equivalent for the first 12 months to get the listed discount. Overage billing at the committed per-token rate (we can provide forecast buckets).
- Payment terms: our standard is Net 30, but we can offer Net 45 for this deal as a one-time concession.
- Invoicing: monthly in arrears with PO number on invoices.
- Taxes: customer-responsible; we will collect applicable sales tax/VAT per law.

I've attached a redlined Order Form (v2) that reflects the minimum commit and Net 45. Can you confirm whether procurement will accept Net 45 or if we should escalate to finance for Net 60?

Attachment: BrightBridge_OrderForm_v2_redlines.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Next steps I suggest:
1) You review v2 and flag any material commercial redlines.
2) If Net 60 is non-negotiable, I'll loop in Monica (finance) and propose a short memo for approval.
3) Once commercials are agreed, we'll circulate final for signature (DocuSign).

Looping in Laura (cc) to keep track on the sales side.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-02-16T13:25:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Order form commercial items — need confirmation

Laura/Monica/Rishi — forwarding BrightBridge's ask. Key negotiation points: minimum commit ($50k ARR equiv), Net 45 vs Net 60, monthly invoicing/PO, taxes pass-through.

Can finance confirm impact of Net 45 vs Net 60 on cashflow and if we need to request any billing security? Rishi — any redline concerns on the tax/invoicing language or the proposed commit phrasing?

I attached the v2 redlines I just sent them. Would appreciate quick takes so we can keep momentum.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-17T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Order form commercial items — need confirmation

Karthik — quick legal read of v2. High-level comments:

- Minimum commit language: prefer to specify an annual committed spend of $50,000 with a clear definition of how overage rates are calculated and when they kick in (recommend adding a one-paragraph formula).
- Net terms: from a legal/commercial risk perspective, Net 60 is acceptable only with a credit check and a signed purchase order that references the Order Form. Finance note: Net 60 increases credit exposure. If marketing/sales want to hold firm at Net 45, that is a reasonable middle ground.
- Taxes: add a clause stating Redwood will invoice applicable taxes and that customer must provide tax exemption documentation where applicable; also include how cross-border VAT will be handled (we will tax per jurisdiction).
- Invoicing cadence: call out monthly invoicing in arrears unless the customer requests prepaid billing. If customer wants advance billing for committed capacity, note it as optional and specify invoice timing.

I've drafted a short redline doc with inline comments: RBW_OrderForm_Redlines_rishi.docx (DOCX, 45KB). If procurement insists on Net 60, please let me know and I'll prepare a brief for finance approval (credit check / security).

Rishi
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
[Attachment: RBW_OrderForm_Redlines_rishi.docx]

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@brightbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightbridgehealth.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Agreement on commercial points & next steps (Order Form)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the quick review. Circling back with what we can commit to and the proposed path to signature.

Agreed commercial highlights (per attached final):
- Minimum commit: $50,000 (annual committed spend for year 1). Discount tiers apply against committed units; overages billed at committed unit rate unless new tiers are negotiated.
- Payment terms: Net 45 (one-time concession) — Redwood will accept Net 45 for this Order Form. If BrightBridge requests Net 60, we'll require a credit review and a PO referencing the Order Form.
- Invoicing: monthly, in arrears, with PO number on the invoice. If you prefer prepaid billing for committed capacity, we can provide alternate invoice timing (please advise).
- Taxes: You are responsible for applicable taxes; Redwood will collect sales tax/VAT when required. Please forward any tax-exempt certificates where relevant.

Attachments: BrightBridge_OrderForm_Final_for_signature.pdf (PDF, 140KB)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/ABC-1234
HubSpot Deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/98765

If that aligns with procurement, I'll send the DocuSign envelope and we can aim to have the signed Order Form by end of week. If procurement cannot accept Net 45, let me know immediately and I'll escalate for a credit check and approval.

Thanks again — looking forward to closing this one.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
